# RAVEN ROCK — Audit & Redesign Proposal
**Date:** 2026-07-25 · **Server:** Paper 1.21.11 @ 10.80.13.14 · **Authority:** `docs/raven-rock/planning/coordinates.yaml` (cross-checked vs `site-plan.md`) · **Status: PROPOSAL — nothing here is to be built until a human signs off.**

## 1) Confidence Preamble

**Most of the complex WAS testable, and every verdict below rests on loaded-chunk evidence — with two exceptions: portal N5 and the entire western half of T4/N6 were unloaded and are INCONCLUSIVE.** Do not read those two as "missing"; they are unknowns.

Why the rest can be trusted: this server returns a **distinct third reply for unloaded positions** — `That position is not loaded` — which is provably different from `Test failed`. Calibration (`execute if block 5000 40 5000 #minecraft:base_stone_overworld` → `That position is not loaded`) plus live confirmation during this audit (`execute if block 285 18 -30 …` → `That position is not loaded` at N5) mean HANDOFF trap #7 is fully neutralized here: **`Test failed` always means "real block, doesn't match", never "chunk unloaded".**

Coverage map (from `forceload query`, 184 chunks, plus player-proximity loading — 6 players online throughout):

|---|---|---|
| Caverns A, B, C + N7 + all liner courses | Force-loaded (verified chunk-by-chunk) | Fully surveyed, ~210 probes by the cavern auditor + refuter |
| N4 mouth + T1 upper (chunks z −19..−18) | Force-loaded | Surveyed |
| N3 mouth (chunks [−10..−9, 17..18]) | Force-loaded | Surveyed |
| Shaft RR-Z5 / N9 / S1 east (chunks [12,−2],[12,−1]) | Force-loaded | Surveyed |
| T1 mid, T2 both legs, T3 to x≈230, C1, C2, all four buildings | Loaded at probe time (players/transient) — all replies were pass/fail, never "not loaded" | Surveyed |
| **N5 mouth (+285,18,−30) and T3 east of x≈230** | **NOT LOADED** | **INCONCLUSIVE** |
| **N6 mouth (−290,10,+5) and T4 west of x≈−190** | **NOT LOADED** | **INCONCLUSIVE** |
| RR-Z4 "no stray voids" discipline across the 600×600 envelope | Only spot-checked via ~30 control probes | Not a full survey; no stray void found, but absence not proven |

Nothing in this report launders an unknown into a finding. Where I could not discriminate (e.g. blast-door leaves, DS-01 signs, natural-cave-vs-breach), I say so.

## 3) Redesign

Ordered by severity. All work applies the two disciplines that demonstrably worked on this project: **LINE BEFORE YOU HOLLOW** (or here: seal before you drain) and **CUT THEN FILL AS SEPARATE, REPLACE-SCOPED FINAL PASSES** — never interleaved.

### R1 — Cavern C aquifer seal + drain (BLOCKER)

**Root cause:** inner north liner course z=−36 was never placed (or was consumed); source water sits against the excavation and cascades in at z=−35.

**Construction order — the order IS the fix; draining first will simply refill (the exact mistake Cavern A already taught):**

1. **Seal the source plane first.** Fill z=−36, x[−185,−130], y[−18,28] → `minecraft:stone`, **replace-scoped to `minecraft:water` and `minecraft:air` only** (the segment at x=−170 is already dry stone — do not cut it). Volume ≈ 56×47 = 2,632/course; well under the fill cap, but still verify (`execute if block −150 10 −36 minecraft:stone` at 6+ stations, y−17/0/10/20/27, x −185/−160/−135).
2. **Seal the secondary east ingress.** Fill x=−114, z[−35,15], y[−18,28] → stone, replace water|air; then verify the x=−115 wall plane column at z=13/15/−20 reads no `water[level=0]`.
3. **Only then drain.** Replace `minecraft:water` → `minecraft:air` inside the cavern interior box x[−185,−115] z[−35,15] y[−17,27], **explicitly excluding the N7 basin box x[−170,−130] z[−34,−26] y[−18,−14]** (see §4 — the basin is level=0 source water and a naive drain will empty it). Drain in three sub-boxes around the exclusion, ≤32k blocks each, verify each.
4. **Drain the T4 junction pocket** at x[−187,−185] z[−12,−8] y[−17,−12] (leak water confirmed standing at (−185,−16,−10)) with the same scoped replace.
5. **Re-verify dry:** repeat the auditor's 35-point floor sweep at y−17; require 0 wet.

**Palette:** plain `stone` to match the existing as-built liner stand-in. The Z-ROCK greenstone finish (deepslate/tuff/cobbled_deepslate mass, mossy_cobblestone/moss_block/glow_lichen stipple, **no granite ever**) remains a separate finishing campaign across all three caverns — do not couple it to this repair.

### R2 — N9 head-house + shaft cap (MISSING element)

Site reality: local surface is ~y62, not the y64 MSA plane (open question OQ-A below decides grading). Proposal assuming a y62 sit:

- **Footprint:** 9×9, x[196,204] z[−19,−11], centred on the bore. Floor slab at y62 (`gray_concrete`), collar ring of `chiseled_stone_bricks` around the open 3×3 mouth x[199,201] z[−16,−14], guarded by `iron_bars` railing.
- **Walls** y63–66: `light_gray_concrete` mass, `stone_bricks` corners, `gray_stained_glass` clerestory at y65; **door:** `iron_door` in the west face at (196,63,−15) facing MSA (button-operated, Z-PORTAL blast_door_motif: iron_block + polished_deepslate frame, 1-wide yellow/black hazard chevron ring on the floor at the threshold).
- **Roof** y67: `smooth_stone_slab` hip over a `gray_concrete` deck; `lightning_rod` finial (echoes RR-B2). `sea_lantern` in the ceiling + `soul_lantern` pair flanking the door.
- **Order:** forceload the 2 chunks → floor/collar → walls → roof → fixtures → verify → release forceload. All blocks in y62–67, inside the RR-Z5 whitelist column — the ONLY sanctioned above-y41 work.

## 4) Execution Safety — mandatory for whoever runs this

1. **`/fill` silently no-ops above ~32,768 blocks and reports nothing.** Chunk every fill: R1's seal plane is safe (≈2.6k) but the R1 drain interior is ~70×50×45 ≈ 158k — split into ≥6 sub-boxes. **Verify after every single fill with probes before issuing the next**; a silent no-op followed by more passes is how half-built states happen.
2. **Replace-scoping is NOT a safety mechanism.** A grading pass on this project already destroyed a road because its surface material wasn't in the protected set. Every cutting/draining pass needs an **explicit exclusion list of existing footprints**, enforced by geometry (sub-boxes that never intersect the exclusions), not by material filters alone. For R1 specifically: **exclude the N7 basin box x[−170,−130] z[−34,−26] y[−18,−14]** — basin water is `level=0` source and materially identical to the target of a water→air drain; only geometry protects it. Also exclude RR-B4's footprint x[−170,−130] z[−24,4] from any Cavern C pass.
3. **Forceload has a per-command chunk cap; an oversized request (e.g. 620×620) fails silently and every subsequent probe reads FAIL.** Scope force-loads to the working area only (R2/R6 need ≤4 chunks each), then **run `forceload query` and confirm your chunks are actually in the list** before probing or filling. Release when done — 184 chunks are already pinned and the budget is not infinite.
4. **The y41 ceiling is absolute.** Every fill command must assert max-y ≤ 41 **except**: (a) the RR-Z5 column x[193,207] z[−22,−8] (R2/R3 work to y67), and (b) the four portal-throat corridors at the mouths. Recommended mechanical check: before any batch, grep the command list for a y-argument > 41 and require each hit to be inside exemption (a) or (b) by coordinate.
5. **DS-01 disclosure signs are REQUIRED at all four portals (REF-015)** — the build is an openly-labelled creative interpretation of a classified site, and the signs are what keep it honest. Text (4 lines, fits vanilla sign limits):
   > `RAVEN ROCK` / `CREATIVE INTERPRETATION` / `real interior classified` / `geometry invented — REF-015`
   Placements (wall signs on the headwall beside each throat, facing the approach):
   - N4: (3, 20, −286) facing north, and mirror at (−3, 20, −286)
   - N3: (−147, 20, 286) facing south, mirror at (−153, 20, 286)
   - N5: (286, 20, −27) facing east — **after** R6 verification of the mouth
   - N6: (−291, 12, 8) facing west — **after** R6 verification
   - Bonus (recommended): one inside the N9 head-house at (200, 64, −12).
   Sign placement is exempt from nothing: N4/N3 signs sit at y20, well under y41; the N9 sign is inside the RR-Z5 exemption.
6. **Cut then fill, never interleaved** (two tunnel floors already failed to interleaving): any pass that both opens voids and lays treads/floors must be two passes, with the fill as a final `replace minecraft:air`-scoped sweep.
7. **Do not `kill`/SIGTERM anything, and remember `POST /api/admin/restart` is a stop, not a restart** (systemd `Restart=on-failure`) — irrelevant to fills but relevant if bots execute this work.

## 6) Open Questions for the Human

- **OQ-A — N9 elevation:** grade the head-house site up to the y64 MSA plane (more earthworks, consistent skyline) or sit it on natural ~y62 grade (zero earthworks, 2-block step down from MSA)? R2 is drafted for y62.
- **OQ-B — N7 identity:** amend the docs to one basin, or build the x=−150 partition to honour "Reservoirs 1 & 2"? (Recommendation: amend — the yaml itself calls the two-reservoir figure non-authoritative.)
- **OQ-C — RR-B3 width:** accept as-built 36×30 and amend the plan, or widen to 44×30? (Recommendation: amend; widening a finished building risks the cavern clearances and re-opens interior work.)
- **OQ-D — Buffer void over Cavern A:** approve the worldgen-vs-breach determination method (fresh-seed comparison / visual inspection), and pre-decide the outcome actions: natural → doc annotation only; artificial → backfill + SP-03 defect entry.
- **OQ-E — Blast doors:** approve a visual inspection of N1/N2 before R4; if leaves exist somewhere my 9 probe points missed, R4 shrinks to the floor-course completion only.
- **OQ-F — Cavern C drain method:** approve the R1 seal-first order and the geometric N7 exclusion. Anyone proposing "just fill the cavern water with air" without the exclusion must be stopped.
- **OQ-G — DS-01 text:** approve the exact 4-line sign wording and placements in §4.5, or supply preferred wording.
- **OQ-H — N5/N6 unknowns:** approve the 4-chunk forceload verification pass (R6) before any decision about the east/west portals; nothing about them should be assumed either way.
- **OQ-I — Landing design:** perimeter-ring landings with an open 3×3 centre drop + ladder (R3 as drafted), or full-floor landings with a hatch? Ring is probe-friendly and preserves the "bored shaft" read.
- **OQ-J — Finishing tier:** authorize (now or defer) the Z-ROCK greenstone finish for all three caverns and the Z-RESERVOIR dressing for N7 — currently the entire complex is in documented andesite/stone/clay stand-ins.
